name: app-flow-home-dashboard-with-weekly-progress-and-route-card
title: Flow cycling app home dashboard: greeting, weekly progress bar, stat cards and a dark route-summary card
whatItIs: A light page with 'Akıllı Takip.' and 'Gerçek Zamanlı Performans Analizi.' headlines, a phone home screen greeting 'Günaydın, Ahmet' with a weekly progress bar (3/5 rides), three stat cards (distance, time, miles) and a recent-ride thumbnail, plus a separate dark route-summary card with a green route line, distance and date.
whatItMeans: Encouraging and legible; a personal greeting and weekly bar make daily opens feel like progress, not just data.
techniques: Greet the user by name with a friendly prompt.
Show a weekly goal as a simple progress bar.
Summarise a completed route as its own shareable card.

vocabulary.definition: A bar showing how far along a goal is.
A compact summary of one completed route.
